name: dataforb2b
label: DataForB2B
description: Power your sales or recruiting AI agent with live B2B data. DataForB2B is a people and company search API with 70+ filters including job title, skills, company size, LinkedIn URL, funding stage, investor, past employers, certifications, years of experience, GitHub repositories, languages and more.

token.label: API Key
token.description: Your DataForB2B API key. Get it from https://app.dataforb2b.ai

reasoning_search.label: Reasoning Search
reasoning_search.description: Describe who you are looking for in plain language. An AI agent builds the best filters and runs the search. It may return status "needs_input" with questions — answer by calling again with the returned session_id and an answers object.

query.label: Query
query.description: Plain-language description, e.g. "Heads of Sales at French fintech scale-ups" (max 3000 chars). Required on the first call.

category.label: Category
category.description: Whether to search people or companies

maxResults.label: Max Results
maxResults.description: Number of results for the final search (1-100)

sessionId.label: Session ID
sessionId.description: Session id returned by a previous call. Send it back to answer questions or refine the same search.

answers.label: Answers (JSON)
answers.description: Answers to a needs_input turn, e.g. {"company_size":"201-500"}. Requires Session ID.

enrichLive.label: Enrich Live
enrichLive.description: Enrich results with fresh live data instead of cached data

enrich_profile.label: Enrich Profile
enrich_profile.description: Retrieve detailed professional data, work/personal email and phone for a person.

profileIdentifier.label: Profile Identifier
profileIdentifier.description: LinkedIn URL, public ID, or encoded ID

enrich_company.label: Enrich Company
enrich_company.description: Retrieve comprehensive information about a company.

companyIdentifier.label: Company Identifier
companyIdentifier.description: Company slug, LinkedIn URL, or encoded ID
